title: Oracle vs spot
description: How far the oracle that settles this venue is from the blended spot price. Near settlement, that gap is the difference between winning and losing.

state.label: Divergence state
state.description: Aligned when the oracle sits within a threshold of spot, diverged when it does not. Diverged means the venue may settle away from where spot says.

divergence_bps.label: Oracle gap
divergence_bps.description: Oracle price minus blended spot as a share of price, in basis points. Positive means the oracle is reading higher than spot.
